_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Communications Security (COMSEC) Integration Test Report (ITR)
summary: Provides data and information necessary to evaluate a system's compliance with host integration requirements based on an approved Integration Evaluation Document, including test results and recommended corrective actions.
use_relationship:
The COMSEC Integration Test Report (ITR) provides data and information necessary to evaluate compliance of a system with its host integration requirements based on an approved Integration Evaluation Document (IED) (see DI-SCRE-82522), including the discussion of recommended corrective actions, if needed.

This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to all systems integrating National Security Agency (NSA) High Assurance Devices (HADs) and provides a detailed description of each test and the subsequent results used to validate the assessment of how the HAD is being securely integrated into any host system. The intent of this document is to provide sufficient information regarding the integration testing of the system to determine the adequacy of the design and to ensure that all host integration security requirements are met. The criteria to be tested are outlined in the program-specific host integration requirements and Integration Evaluation Document (IED) DI-SCRE-82522, cited above. For the purposes of this document, the term "system" refers to the entire space vehicle not including the hosted payloads.

This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for deliverable generation in support of the specific and discrete task requirements for this data item, as described in the contract.

Note: This DID is directly linked to and associated with DI-SCRE-82522, COMSEC Integration Evaluation Document (IED).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Compliance Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The COMSEC ITR shall demonstrate, describe, and maintain compliance with the applicable sections of each document cited below. Email jyoti.woodman.1@spaceforce.mil to request access to compliance documents:

children.title: CMO-S, Host Integration Functional Requirements Document for the Space Vehicle Design of a Bypass External to the Cryptographic Device
Additionally, in conducting testing associated
children.content: Additionally, in conducting testing associated with the COMSEC ITR deliverable document, the data provided in the COMSEC ITR shall be compliant with the Contractor's COMSEC IED, separately described under DI-SCRE-82522 and approved by the Government.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor's COMSEC ITR shall contain narrative content, diagrams, and technical detail addressing each of the topics delineated in the following major sections and subsections, and provide data using the electronic preparation instructions below. The COMSEC ITR shall:

children.title: Be formatted strictly in accordance with the COMSEC ITR Template
children.content: established for this purpose and that is included in this DID.

children.title: Be appropriately classified and portion marked
children.content: in accordance with requirements provided in the Contractor's DD Form 254.

children.title: Be submitted in Microsoft Word format
children.content: for initial submission and either Microsoft Word format or Adobe PDF format after review and validation for submission to the Government Program Office. Microsoft Word format is preferred as it supports more efficient tracking and management of changes.

children.title: Not contain embedded files
children.content: (i.e., Microsoft Visio drawings). All embedded pictures and diagrams must be converted to a JPG, PNG, TIFF, or GIF.

children.title: Contractor Program Manager's name and telephone number
children.content: and, if applicable, the Government Program Office Point of Contact name and office designator

children.title: Include a Revision Page
children.content: listing all past changes to the document in reverse chronological order.

children.title: Include a list of Reference and Compliance Documents
children.content: to include those cited in 1. & 2., above, and all other documents used to develop the COMSEC ITR.

children.title: Include a Table defining all the abbreviations and acronyms
Be completed using the Integration Test Report (ITR) Template, Version 1.0
children.content: included in this DID. Note: Not all requested information will apply. Wherever requested information does not apply, identify it as "N/A."

children.title: System Requirements and Operational Environment
children.content: Provide a concise description of the scope and intent of the COMSEC ITR. This information includes an overview of the integration components and technology, if applicable, of the system to be protected as well as a summary of the tests to be completed. Include a list of tests performed with pass/fail or met/not met indications. Include a table listing the applicable host integration functional requirements.

children.title: Security Requirement Tests
children.content: This section includes the detailed results of each test by listing each integration security requirement and the evidence used to verify the system's compliance. Use tables, figures, and detailed descriptions to adequately convey the results and conclusions of each test. Functions to be tested include, but are not limited to:

children.title: External security functions such as bypass policy enforcement
Conclusions and Recommendations
children.content: Conclusions and recommendations shall be provided, including results of the tests in brief narrative form, a discussion of any remedial actions already initiated, and proposed corrective measures required (if necessary) to assure compliance of the system with integration security requirements.

children.title: Operational Security Doctrine (OSD) associated with the integrated HAD
Interface Control Documents (ICD) associated with the integrated HAD
User's Guide/Manual associated with the integrated HAD
Appendix A: Security Design Requirements Compliance and Validation
Appendix B: Comment and Response Matrix
children.content: Appendix B of the COMSEC ITR tracks comments along with the appropriate Developer responses and changes. These responses must answer the question or comment and reference corresponding locations in the body of the document where the content was updated in response to the comment, and marked by change bars. These comments and responses include remedial actions conducted to address deficiencies and remain within the COMSEC ITR for each revision.
